# MH Hospital

> MH Hospital patient operations portal — book in-person visits, launch encrypted video consultations, and manage medical records from a single interface.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of MH Hospital services, departments, and virtual care.
- [Departments](/departments): Full directory of clinical specialties.
- [Physicians](/physicians): Searchable directory of MH Hospital doctors.
- [Book Appointment](/book): Multi-step wizard to schedule in-person or video visits.
- [About](/about): About MH Hospital and its care philosophy.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone numbers, and emergency contact.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Patient, doctor, and admin sign-in.
